description: This file provides utility functions for reading and writing JSON files securely, handling symlinks, and ensuring file permissions and directory states. It includes functions to load and save JSON data with safe file operations.

methods.name: trySetSecureMode
methods.description: Sets file permissions to secure mode (600) if supported.

methods.name: trySyncDirectory
methods.description: Synchronizes directory to disk, with best-effort error handling.

methods.name: readSymlinkTargetPath
methods.description: Resolves the target path of a symbolic link.

methods.name: resolveJsonWriteTarget
methods.description: Resolves the final target path for writing, following symlinks and detecting loops.

methods.name: renameJsonFileWithFallback
methods.description: Attempts to rename a temporary file to target, with fallback to copy and delete if rename fails.

methods.name: writeTempJsonFile
methods.description: Writes JSON payload to a temporary file with secure permissions.
